IT'S TIME FOR SOME FUCKING STORY, BROS. I liked the story a lot, actually. I already said my piece on the story versus porn thing in the credits, so I won't bring it up again here. However, I want to make it clear that this series is good and I enjoy it. I'm not criticizing the content, just suggesting what I think is a better way to distribute it. Unless it does a total 180 and drops in quality for some reason, which I don't expect at all, I will continue translating these volumes as they come out. I love violence in media too so no, a little meat grinding and character death will not make me want to stop. It will only excite me more.

Happy fapping!
